courses.title: How agents work
courses.summary: What actually happens when an AI agent takes on a task: the model, the tools it calls, and the loop that ties them together.

lectures.title: What an agent is
lectures.summary: A model, some tools, and a loop. Where an agent stops being a chatbot.

lectures.title: The agent loop
lectures.summary: Think, act, observe, repeat. Following one task from prompt to finish.

lectures.title: Tools
lectures.summary: How a model asks for a tool call, who runs it, and what comes back.

lectures.title: The context window
lectures.summary: What fills it, what it costs, and what happens when it runs out.

lectures.title: Planning and long tasks
lectures.summary: Breaking work down, keeping track of progress, and knowing when to stop.

lectures.title: Subagents
lectures.summary: When one agent hands work to another, and what each one gets to see.

lectures.title: Making agents reliable
lectures.summary: Evals, guardrails, and deciding what an agent may do without asking.
